text: I twisted both my ankles, was terrified they would be broken. We were referred from Budva Health Center, the lady at the reception was AWFUL. She wasn’t wearing a name badge but it happened 06/10/26 night shift (about 10-11 pm). I want her to be warned quite firmly about respect, communication and professionalism since she was pack of them all. She shouted at me and my husband (I already was crying due to horrendous pain) purely because we were speaking in English-the universal language. Her attitude was rude, body language was disgusting and I won’t ever come back to this place. And the orthopedic doctor only took 5 minutes to check my xray results. I wasn’t happy with the xray as it was requested insufficient. Only one angle was used with my both feet.
Sve pohvale za odeljenje neurologije! Svi su toliko divni i posvećeni iako nema dovoljno kadra.

Terrible place. Terrible horrendous reception. Lady did nothing but shout at us. Absolutely terrifying experience. I have never seen people being shout at for not knowing the local language. At one point I thought she was being racist. Would prefer going back with broken leg without any treatment than coming here. The worst.

Disgusting people at the reception. Our friend got injured at the Central Budva. We went to nearby hospital at the Budva central. Lovely bunch helped us and referred us to this hospital before midnight. Even arranged us a cab.
After that we arrived at this hospital, there were a lady and a man at the reception and lady was nothing short of a pure evil. She was shouting at us as if we had cursed her family for centuries. Incredibly rude, I cant even describe it how angry i got. If you have to go to this hospital, and I hope it never happens, try to talk with someone else or take someone local with you to the reception.

Želim da izrazim iskrenu zahvalnost i veliko poštovanje prema cijelom timu bolnice Risan u kojoj se najmanje ulagalo a previše očekivalo-personal uvjek ljubazan i na usluzi kako pacijenta tako i članovima porodice  a to jr posebno doprinjeo  dr Popović Vlado, veliki čovjek i izuzetni neurohirurg.
Dr Popović je, prije svega, čovjek koji uliva povjerenje, sigurnost i nadu. Njegova stručnost, posvećenost pacijentu, smirenost i ljudskost ostavljaju snažan utisak. U trenucima kada je čovjeku najteže, mnogo znači imati ljekara koji pristupa pacijentu sa razumijevanjem, strpljenjem i iskrenom željom da pomogne kao i saradnja sa članovima porodice dotičnog pacijenta.
Kao neurohirurg, dr Popović je vrhunski stručnjak, ali ono što ga posebno izdvaja jeste njegova ljudskost i odnos prema pacijentima. Takvi ljekari vraćaju vjeru u medicinu i pokazuju koliko znanje, iskustvo i dobro srce mogu zajedno da znače.
Velike pohvale i zahvalnost upućujem i cijelom osoblju bolnice Risan na profesionalnosti, ljubaznosti i brizi o pacijentima. Od prvog do posljednjeg trenutka osjećao/la sam poštovanje i pažnju.
Od srca preporučujem bolnicu Risan i dr Popovića. Hvala vam na svemu što radite za svoje pacijente. Želim vam mnogo uspjeha i da još dugo budete oslonac i nada ljudima kojima je pomoć najpotrebnija.

Moja dvanaestogodišnja ćerka je povrijedila prst na nozi. Uradili smo rendgen u Budvi i uputili su nas u bolnicu u Risnu.

Stigli smo u Risan kod ortopeda u 13:00, sačekali svoj red i ušli kod doktora u 14:40. Doktor nije htio da nas primi, rekao je da je umoran i da dođemo sjutra, iako mu radno vrijeme traje do 15:00.

Na recepciji smo tražili da pozovu dežurnog doktora, ali su odbili i samo nam rekli: „Dođite sjutra.“

Wir waren mit unserem Sohn (2 Jahre) dort wegen einem geschwollenen Finger. Das Personal, besonders am Empfang, waren alle super herzlich und haben dafür gesorgt, dass wir nirgends lange warten mussten. Es waren vor jeder Station lange Warteschlangen und wir durften immer vor. Das war wirklich super und vorbildlich. Vielen Dank!
Brza i profesionalna usluga

Wir hatten noch nie so eine schlimmer Erfahrung gemacht, keine Ärzte vorhanden, die Damen an der Rezeption unfreundlich!!!
Mein Sohn hat den Arm gebrochen und wir warteten gefüllt 4h!! unfassbar wirklich...Die Medizinische versorgung ist nicht verfügbar...

I would like to express my sincere thanks to Dr Anika Dajevic and her assistant for the outstanding care I received after I had an accident during the night of 12 July and fell, requiring stitches to my face just below and above my eye. My injury was treated with exceptional skill, and I felt completely safe throughout the entire procedure, which was carried out with the utmost professionalism. The wound has healed beautifully, and the scar is now barely visible.

Tokom boravka na odmoru u Crnoj Gori doživjela sam povredu. Liječena sam na Odjeljenju ortopedije bolnice u Risnu, gdje sam operisana zbog otvorenog preloma patele.

Duboko sam dirnuta odnosom svih zdravstvenih radnika – od ekipe Hitne pomoći, preko Prijemnog odjeljenja, do osoblja Ortopedskog odjeljenja.

Od srca zahvaljujem cijelom kolektivu Ortopedskog odjeljenja na profesionalizmu, brizi, pažnji i podršci. Iskreno hvala svakome od vas na vašem radu, humanosti i pomoći. Želim vam dobro zdravlje, blagostanje, mnogo uspjeha u radu i sve najbolje u životu.

Posebno želim da izrazim svoju zahvalnost ljekaru koji me je operisao, ortopedskom hirurgu dr Đuru Zgradoviću.

Poštovani doktore, hvala vam na vašim zlatnim rukama, vrhunskom profesionalizmu i nesebičnoj posvećenosti poslu. Vi nijeste samo izuzetan stručnjak, već i dobra, iskrena i saosjećajna osoba koja uliva nadu, donosi mir i vraća vjeru u ozdravljenje.

Od srca vam hvala za sve. Duboki naklon za vaš trud, humanost i veliko srce.

S poštovanjem,

Nadija iz Ukrajine

Das Krankenhaus des Horrors!
Die Schwere der Verletzungen an meinem linken Unterschenkel wurde auf dem Röntgenbild vom diensthabenden Arzt nicht erkannt. Es folgte eine völlig unprofessionelle und unfassbar schmerzhafte Behandlung, in welcher der Unterschenkel mit verschobenen Knochenbrüchen einfach eingegipst wurde. Zurück in Deutschland folgten zwei Operationen. Die Ärzte in Deutschland waren fassungslos über die in Montenegro erfolgte medizinische Behandlung.

I was denied care today. I was told to come here for help with my pain, but when I arrived I was told that a doctor could not see me. The staff member I spoke with was hostile, raised her voice at me, and I felt intimidated throughout the interaction. I also asked about my prescribed pain medication and was told I would “never be prescribed” it because it was a sedative, even though the medication I was asking about was for pain management. I showed that I already have a valid prescription from my doctor, but I still wasn’t given the opportunity to discuss my situation with a physician. I left feeling dismissed and without receiving the care I had been told to seek.

Went in with a twisted ankle and suspected break at 8:30pm on a Sunday. It was quiet and very efficient. We were able to borrow a wheelchair from the entrance easily. It took an hour to get an x-ray, consultation and an immobilisation splint. Very clean and clearly newly renovated. Price was reasonable - $60. All clinicians were direct and no fuss.

We used Google translate to give main information to staff. The specialist doctor had good English.

Я легально работаю и плачу налоги при этом я не имею права на бесплатное медицинское страхование, окей, так бывает, но здесь меня отказались принимать с травмой руки даже за деньги, так наверно быть не должно.
SRAM VAS I STID BILO

The worst hospital I've ever been in. I was there for seven days with a fracture, and now I have to spend another two weeks in another hospital to correct the "work" of these doctors. Specifically, the surgeon, Dr. Dino, and the hospital director. These incompetent people didn't correct the bone displacement and applied an external fixator to a bone with a huge displacement. They didn't give me a tetanus shot, even though they were required to do so by all the rules. They allowed the wound area to become infected. The infection caused my temperature to rise above 39 degrees , but the orderly insisted it was just the fracture. In seven days with an open fracture, they only dressed the wound twice (which caused dirt to accumulate and the infection to develop). For an entire floor of patients, only one staff member remained at night, and he was always smoking somewhere and it was impossible to reach him. Just think about it: they discharged me with a catheter in my vein that had been inserted seven days earlier and sent me to the airport. Even the nurse at the airport was shocked when she removed it. I really hope the Montenegrin Ministry of Health will pay attention to this horror happening there. I wish everyone a speedy recovery and I don't recommend anyone end up in this "hospital." They're more likely to cripple you than cure you. By the way, I'm currently being treated at another hospital for this blood poisoning, and they charged me €2,500. Good luck to everyone!
Приятные сотрудники, большая парковка. Очередь большая, но в целом подождать можно. Были в травматологии, остановка дружелюбная.

Moja kćerka je slomila nogu. U bolnici su rekli da vikendom nema dostupnih doktora. Nisu mi htjeli dati uputnicu za Podgoricu.
Više sile će te kazniti!
Pyszne żarcie.  Polecam. Ogromne porcję za niewielkie pieniądze. Świetna obsługa. Bardzo rodzinna atmosfera. Pozdrawiam z Polski
